evidence: Carries the Build system label and refactors CMake build targets, cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in, and target compile definitions.
rationale: Reduces rebuild times during reconfiguration by scoping feature flags to specific targets rather than triggering full tree rebuilds through bitcoin-build-config.h. Reconfiguring build options such as toggling GUI or wallet support previously rebuilt non-GUI targets needlessly. Contributor friction and build speed improvements rank as worthwhile P3 work.
